verdict.rationale: Mintlify documents a hosted search MCP server for each docs site. AI tools such as Claude, Cursor and ChatGPT can connect to it to search and retrieve content from that site (mintlify-docs-7, mintlify-docs-43), and the pricing page lists 'MCP server' as a platform feature (mintlify-docs-60). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the hosted server works as described, and details of the exposed tools and configuration (e.g. auth, page-fetch semantics) beyond summary-level docs.
